title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
description: Scholarships awarded across all Irish higher education institutions to high-calibre students from outside the EU/EEA for one year of study at bachelor's, master's or PhD level.
amount: EUR 10,000 stipend for one year plus a full tuition fee waiver

title: Government of Ireland Postgraduate Scholarship Programme
description: Scholarships for excellent research master's and PhD candidates of any nationality to undertake a postgraduate research degree at an eligible Irish higher education institution.
amount: EUR 25,000 annual stipend plus a contribution to fees (up to EUR 6,000) and eligible research expenses

title: Walsh Scholarship Programme
field: Agriculture, food science, animal and grassland science, environment, agri-economics
description: Funded master's and PhD research positions hosted jointly by Teagasc and an Irish university, advertised against specific projects throughout the year.
amount: Approximately EUR 25,000 per year including a stipend and a contribution to university fees

title: Trinity College Dublin Global Excellence Scholarships
description: Merit-based awards for high-achieving non-EU students accepting an offer for a taught postgraduate programme at Trinity College Dublin.
amount: EUR 5,000 towards tuition up to a full tuition fee waiver for select awards

title: UCD Global Excellence Scholarships
description: Scholarships for outstanding international (non-EU) students commencing an undergraduate or taught master's programme at UCD, awarded as a partial to full tuition fee reduction.
amount: Partial tuition reduction up to 100% of tuition fees for the most competitive awards
